Title: Manoj's Little Adventure

Cast

1. Manoj - 36 years, son
Look: glasses, brown sweater
2. Sonali - 65 years, mother
Look: blue saree, hair in a bun
3. Kavita - 30 years, daughter
Look: green saree

Places

1. The main road - a wide road, traffic lights
2. The road - a paved road, trees along it
3. The living room - a sofa, a table, a big window

Scene 1: The main road - Day

[Manoj stands on the road. Sonali stands near him.]

Sonali: "Manoj, what's the plan today?"

[Manoj starts the car, turns the steering wheel and drives off.]

Sonali: "Hey, look at that!"

[Manoj is driving when he slams on the brakes.]

Manoj (laughing): "Hmm, I see."

[Manoj steps on the accelerator and speeds away in his car.]

Manoj: "I knew it!"

[Manoj's bike skids on the wet road and he falls off.]

Sonali: "I'm ready!"

[A dog runs in front of Manoj's car; he brakes hard and swerves just in time.]

Manoj: "Hmm, I see."

[Manoj loses his balance on the bicycle and falls.]

Manoj: "Exactly right."

Scene 2: The road - Day

[Manoj stands by the road. Sonali stands near him.]

Manoj: "So, here we are!"

[Manoj rides the scooter with Mother sitting behind him.]

Manoj: "That's easy."

[Manoj takes Mother to the market on his motorbike, she sits behind him.]

Manoj (excited): "Wow, how lovely!"

Scene 3: The living room - Day

Sonali: "What a nice place."

[Manoj pours himself a whisky and drinks it.]

Kavita: "Okay, Mom."

[Manoj sips red wine.]

Manoj: "Hmm, I see."

[Manoj staggers drunkenly towards the door.]

Sonali: "What happened?"

[Manoj and Mother clink their glasses.]

Manoj (gently): "What next?"

[Manoj walks slowly across the room while talking on the phone.]

Sonali (gently): "That was fun!"

Scene 4: The road - Day

[Manoj stands by the road. Sonali and Kavita stand near him.]

Sonali: "Let's begin."

[Manoj rides his motorbike to the market.]

Manoj: "Show me too!"

[Manoj starts his scooter and rides off.]

Manoj: "That's great!"

[Manoj drives the car to the office.]

Kavita (surprised): "What happened?"

[Manoj rides the scooter with Mother sitting behind him.]

Kavita: "That's great!"

[Manoj takes Mother to the market on his motorbike, she sits behind him.]

Sonali (softly): "That was such a fun day!"
